communities.name: Study Balance LK
communities.description: A sample space for Sri Lankan students to compare study routines, plan assignments and prepare questions about academic support.

conversationStarters.title: Making space for a busy assignment week
conversationStarters.prompt: What small change would make your workload easier to approach?

conversationStarters.title: Starting when an assignment feels too big
conversationStarters.prompt: What would a manageable first step look like for you?

communities.name: Campus Calm Circle
communities.tagline: A place to put everyday worries into words.
communities.description: A sample circle for discussing everyday worry and preparing questions for professional support when fear affects student life. It cannot assess frightening physical symptoms.

conversationStarters.title: Getting ready for an approaching exam
conversationStarters.prompt: What part of preparation feels within your control today?

conversationStarters.title: Preparing a support conversation
conversationStarters.prompt: What would you like a qualified professional to help you understand?

communities.name: Rest & Routine
communities.tagline: Share realistic ideas for steadier evenings.
communities.description: A sample discussion space about rest and routines around lectures, commuting and shared accommodation. It does not provide medical sleep advice.

conversationStarters.title: Building an evening that fits hostel life
conversationStarters.prompt: What quiet transition could fit your living situation?

conversationStarters.title: A routine for a changing timetable
conversationStarters.prompt: Which part of the day could provide a reliable anchor?

communities.name: Suhada Connections
communities.tagline: Find a comfortable first step toward connection.
communities.description: A sample circle about belonging at university, making contact at your own pace and finding activities that feel welcoming.

conversationStarters.title: A small hello on a new campus
conversationStarters.prompt: What kind of shared activity would feel comfortable to try?

conversationStarters.title: Keeping a connection during a busy week
conversationStarters.prompt: What small form of contact would you welcome?

communities.name: Small Steps Together
communities.tagline: Make room for one manageable moment.
communities.description: A sample space for talking about motivation and manageable daily activities. Peer discussion is optional and does not replace professional support.

conversationStarters.title: A smaller version still counts
conversationStarters.prompt: What is a manageable version of something you value?

conversationStarters.title: Asking for company without explaining everything
conversationStarters.prompt: What kind of company would feel welcome today?

communities.name: Confidence & Kindness
communities.tagline: Practise a more balanced view of yourself.
communities.description: A sample circle for exploring self-criticism, comparison and confidence during university life, without pressure to share personal details.

conversationStarters.title: When the inner critic gets loud
conversationStarters.prompt: What might you say to a friend facing a similar situation?

conversationStarters.title: Noticing effort beyond a grade
conversationStarters.prompt: What specific effort would you like to acknowledge?

communities.name: Space for Grief
communities.tagline: Choose company, quiet or practical support.
communities.description: A sample space for thinking about support after loss. There is no timetable for how to feel, and no need to describe the loss.

conversationStarters.title: What kind of company feels welcome?
conversationStarters.prompt: Would listening, quiet company or practical help feel useful?

conversationStarters.title: Making a demanding day gentler
conversationStarters.prompt: Which demand could be made smaller or more flexible?

communities.name: Relationships & Boundaries
communities.tagline: Put needs and requests into your own words.
communities.description: A sample circle about communication, family expectations and respectful boundaries. If a conversation would be unsafe, seek appropriate help rather than practising it here.

conversationStarters.title: A respectful request about study time
conversationStarters.prompt: What need would you like to express clearly?

conversationStarters.title: Choosing what to share
conversationStarters.prompt: What information would you prefer to keep private?

communities.name: Room to Reset
communities.tagline: Review demands and make space to pause.
communities.description: A sample circle for discussing overload, frustration and realistic requests for help during student life. It does not offer treatment or assess urgency.

conversationStarters.title: One demand I could review
conversationStarters.prompt: Which commitment could be adjusted or shared?

conversationStarters.title: Preparing a pause before responding
conversationStarters.prompt: What would help you make room for a calmer next step?

communities.name: Everyday Support LK
communities.tagline: Prepare a practical request for university support.
communities.description: A sample space for preparing questions about everyday needs such as transport, accommodation and essential expenses. No payments, eligibility decisions or financial records are handled here.

conversationStarters.title: Preparing an accommodation question
conversationStarters.prompt: What would you like to ask your university support office?

conversationStarters.title: Making an essential-expenses support request
conversationStarters.prompt: What practical help would make the biggest difference to your day?

communities.name: Body Respect Circle
communities.tagline: Talk about body-image support without comparison.
communities.description: A sample space for preparing a respectful professional-support conversation about eating or body image. No weights, calorie goals, diet instructions or appearance comparisons are requested.

conversationStarters.title: What would make asking for help easier?
conversationStarters.prompt: What would you like a qualified professional to understand?

conversationStarters.title: Support without comments on appearance
conversationStarters.prompt: What kind of language would feel respectful to you?

communities.name: Making Support Choices
communities.tagline: Prepare questions for confidential professional advice.
communities.description: A sample circle for thinking about confidential advice and support choices around alcohol or substance concerns. It provides no instructions for use, stopping or withdrawal.

conversationStarters.title: Questions before a confidential conversation
conversationStarters.prompt: What would you like to ask about privacy and available support?

conversationStarters.title: Choosing a first contact
conversationStarters.prompt: Who could help you find qualified advice?

communities.name: Support at Your Pace
communities.tagline: Explore support while keeping control of what you share.
communities.description: A sample circle for considering trusted support after difficult experiences. It does not ask for event details or provide trauma-processing exercises.

conversationStarters.title: Choosing what feels comfortable to share
conversationStarters.prompt: What boundary would help you feel more in control of a conversation?

conversationStarters.title: A supportive next step at your pace
conversationStarters.prompt: Would practical help, company or professional support feel useful?
